column1: # Which Pascal routine implements each game-layer function.
# THE ADDRESS AUTHORITY is notes/game_functions.txt; this file adds the third
# column - the routine in src/ that carries the behaviour. tools/implemented.py
# reads it and checks each target really has a body, so a function written up
# but never coded still fails the gate.
# WHY IT IS A FILE AND NOT A COMMENT
# This mapping used to live in src/, as an address inside the comment block
# immediately above each declaration. Two things were wrong with that. It put
# decompilation bookkeeping in source comments, which are for explaining how
# the game works; and the convention was invisible to the compiler, so a
# reformatting pass silently took the count from 149 to 14 while everything
# still built and every self-test still passed.
#   address     VA in akuji.exe, as it appears in notes/game_functions.txt
#   name        the Ghidra name at that address
#   target      unit path under src/, then the routine, qualified for a method
# One address may name a routine another address also names when the original
# is an X/Y pair or two entry points into one body; that is expected. Adding a
# row means the address is claimed as implemented, so add one only when the
